tests.reason: This probe sends only the mode query CSI ? 5522 $ p; it writes nothing through OSC 5522 and reads nothing back, and no probe in this suite reads the clipboard for this mode. The mode reporter answered 2026; CSI ? 5522 $ p and 13 of 14 controls were a measured silence with the fence answered; that silence decides nothing. The observer that would decide it writes a payload through OSC 5522 and reads it back through the OSC 52 read path, which a terminal may gate behind clipboard-read permission.
